items.rationale: The indoor heating-pipe failure falls under §2.4.3. Like-for-like fittings used in the repair are covered under §7.1.7(c), estimated at €12 each.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers fittings used to reconnect the failed run, estimated at €22 each. Under §7.1.8(e), the 28 mm size must match the repaired installation.
The fitting is covered under §7.1.7(c) if used in the documented repair, at about €22 for one elbow. Section 7.1.8(e) excludes fittings that do not match the repaired installation.
Minor fastenings used in the pipe repair are covered under §7.1.7(c), at about €1.50 each.
Clamps needed to secure the repaired pipe are covered installation fixings under §7.1.7(c), estimated at €5 each.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(c) cover the pipe needed for the failed run, not unrelated renewal. The estimate is 6.4 m at about €13/m, provided the invoiced length matches the repair under §7.1.8(e).

Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary repair labour at customary rates; §7.1.5 excludes time spent on the unrelated jobs. The conditional estimate uses the supplied €566 gross prior for 6.75 repair hours.
Necessary helper time on the heating-pipe repair is covered under §7.1.7(g), but time on the other jobs is excluded under §7.1.5. The supplied gross prior for 5.75 repair hours is €394.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the pipe's pre-loss insulation. The supplied gross prior for all six pieces is €146.
Binding wire used to secure the reinstated insulation is a covered consumable under §7.1.7(c), estimated at €22 for 2 kg. Section 7.1.8(e) excludes any quantity not attributable to the repair.
Section 7.1.7(c) permits a lump sum for minor repair consumables, but §7.1.8(c) bars charges for items already billed separately. Allow about €20 for distinct consumables used in the pipe repair.
This is the only travel charge on the plumbing invoice and is covered under §7.1.7(f). The supplied gross prior is €80.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of pipe-repair debris, not discarded flooring from the unaffected room. If the charge is attributable to the pipe repair, the supplied gross prior is €62.
The hallway was unaffected, so §§3.5 and 7.1.5 exclude repainting even though it appears on the same invoice. The conditional gross estimate is 12 m² at €20/m².
The storage-room floor was undamaged and is in a separate room, so neither §7.1.5 nor the continuous-surface exception in §7.1.6 allows payment. The conditional gross estimate is 15 m² at €50/m².
The outdoor tap service was unrelated upkeep, excluded by §§7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a). The conditional gross estimate for the flat-rate service is €90.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes processing fees levied in addition to itemised labour and materials. The €15 conditional figure is a placeholder, not a payable amount.
